CustomField.description: Red marker on an open sale when the model the customer wants has no cars available and no car is on the sale yet.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND(NOT(IsClosed), ISBLANK(Vehicle__c), NOT(ISBLANK(Vehicle_Model_Wanted__c)), Vehicle_Model_Wanted__r.Available_Stock__c = 0), IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_red.gif", "Out of stock") & " Out of stock - request an import", "" )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Shows a red flag when no car of the wanted model is available.
CustomField.label: Stock Alert
